note: Generic cold-start pick-and-place menu over honest LIBERO signals (proprioception, finger contact flags, Astra keypoints). No task-specific constants; no grasp verification, placement correction or retry rules yet (left to RSI).
intent_instructions: Select the next intent whose definition and preconditions match observed_facts and the predicates. Typical order: move_above_object, descend_to_grasp, close_gripper, lift, carry_to_place, lower_to_place, open_gripper, retreat, finish.

intents.name: move_above_object
intents.definition: Gripper open and not above_grasp: move above the estimated grasp point.

intents.name: descend_to_grasp
intents.definition: above_grasp is true and at_grasp is false, gripper open: descend to the grasp point.

intents.name: close_gripper
intents.definition: at_grasp is true and the gripper is open: close the fingers.

intents.name: lift
intents.definition: Gripper closed on the object and not lifted: raise vertically.

intents.name: carry_to_place
intents.definition: lifted is true and above_place is false: carry the held object above the place point.
intents.refpoint: vec(place[0] + grasp[0] - objc[0], place[1] + grasp[1] - objc[1], tcp[2])

intents.name: lower_to_place
intents.definition: above_place is true and the gripper is still closed: lower the object to the release height.
intents.refpoint: vec(tcp[0], tcp[1], place[2] + clear + tcp_at_close[2] - objc[2] + obj_h)

intents.name: open_gripper
intents.definition: The object has been lowered over the place point: open the fingers to release.

intents.name: retreat
intents.definition: released_since_close is true: raise the empty gripper.

intents.name: reopen_and_retry
intents.definition: The grasp failed (gripper closed but the object is not held): open and go back above the grasp point.

intents.name: relook
intents.definition: Ask the camera perception module to look again and refresh object/place estimates and whether the object is held.

intents.name: finish
intents.definition: The object was released at the place and the gripper retreated: stop.

predicates.name: above_grasp
predicates.expr: dist_xy(tcp, grasp) < 0.3*obj_h and tcp[2] > grasp[2] + obj_h
predicates.meaning: gripper is roughly above the grasp point

predicates.name: at_grasp
predicates.meaning: gripper is at the grasp point

predicates.name: lifted
predicates.meaning: closed gripper is raised well above grasp and place heights

predicates.name: above_place
predicates.expr: dist_xy(vec(tcp[0] - grasp[0] + objc[0], tcp[1] - grasp[1] + objc[1], 0), place) < 0.3*obj_h
predicates.meaning: held object is roughly above the place point

predicates.name: at_grasp_relaxed
predicates.expr: contact or (prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and n_same >= 2 and dist(tcp, grasp) < 0.6*obj_h)
predicates.meaning: both fingers touch something, or the descent has stalled close to the grasp point

predicates.name: empty_close
predicates.expr: closed_cmd and n_close >= 1 and opening_at_close < 0.15*open_max and not contact

predicates.name: descent_hit
predicates.expr: prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and not closed_cmd and (left_contact or right_contact) and not contact
predicates.meaning: one finger hit something while descending with open fingers

recoveries.trigger: at_grasp_relaxed and not closed_cmd and not at_grasp and prev == 'descend_to_grasp'

lessons.name: contact during descent
lessons.signature: a finger touches something before the close while descending
lessons.instead: stop descending and look again; the object was probably pushed or is blocked

lessons.name: empty close
lessons.signature: fingers close almost fully without contact
lessons.instead: the object probably moved; look again before regrasping

lessons.name: blocked target
lessons.signature: the target object is occluded or hemmed in by neighbours
lessons.instead: clear the path by pushing the blocker aside, or change the approach direction

lessons.name: high release
lessons.signature: the object is released far above the place surface
lessons.instead: lower the object close to the place surface before opening

lessons.name: strict at-grasp
lessons.signature: descent stalls near the grasp point or both fingers already touch
lessons.instead: treat it as at the grasp point and close

lessons.name: wrong object grasped
lessons.signature: the language names a specific object, a similar neighbour is nearby, and after contact or lift the goal object is still on the table while something else is held
lessons.instead: discard the current grasp estimate and look again for the language-goal object before regrasping

lessons.name: near approach tips tall object
lessons.signature: approaching or descending too close to a tall bottle or can tips or pushes it before the grasp closes
lessons.instead: keep a clear height above the body, center over it, then descend vertically

lessons.name: first-frame identity check
lessons.signature: similar objects are nearby at episode start and the language names a specific one
lessons.instead: match the language goal in the first image before locking grasp and place points

lessons.name: place target may be wrong
lessons.signature: after a successful lift the place region may still refer to the wrong container or surface for the language goal
lessons.instead: verify the place region against the language goal before carrying and releasing

lessons.name: contact without held
lessons.signature: both fingers report contact while the camera says the object is not held
lessons.instead: do not reopen and regrasp yet; refresh perception before treating it as a grasp failure

lessons.name: do not push the goal
lessons.signature: a push-aside clears a blocker near the target
lessons.instead: push only the blocker; never push the language-goal object

lessons.name: wait for official success
lessons.signature: the policy finishes or retries right after opening over the place region
lessons.instead: success is only the official containment check; after release keep waiting for settle and the official success signal, do not finish early
